# Device taxonomy (fixture)

## Humor devices

| id | definition |
|---|---|
| deadpan | no signal a joke is happening |
| anti_climax | big buildup, tiny payoff |
| specificity | the odd precise detail |
| incongruous_register | corporate language for trivial things |

## Voice devices

| id | definition |
|---|---|
| fragment | a sentence without a verb |
| one_word_line | a single word line |
